_source: Star Citizen game files via StarBreaker
_assumptions: Units are as the records give them; none is named in the records. Pressure reads as atmospheres, room temperature as kelvin, humidity as a 0..1 fraction, actor temperatures as degrees Celsius (all inferred, docs/datacore/rooms-atmosphere.md#units).
compositions[].gases[].share is parts / sum(parts) of that composition, rounded to 6 places. Whether parts are by mass or by volume is not established.

connectors[].apertureAreaSqmEstimate is the product of the two largest defaultAreaBounds axes, on the inference that the thinnest axis is the depth through the wall. No axis is fixed as depth: y is not the thinnest on about a fifth of the connector classes (hangar doors, lifts), and orientationMode AutoDetectWidest on 692 of 694 classes reads as the engine picking the opening plane from the bounds.
actorThresholds damage figures are copied as given; that they are per second is inferred from StatusEffectDamageOverTime, not stated.
